question: Where can I find a university that are within 180 kilometers and lie south of Country Inn & Suites, Springfield, IL?
sql: SELECT poi_name FROM pois WHERE amenity = 'university' AND ST_DWithin( pois.geometry::geography, (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Country Inn & Suites%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Springfield%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%IL%' LIMIT 1)::geography, 180000 ) AND ST_Y(pois.geometry) < ST_Y( (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Country Inn & Suites%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Springfield%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%IL%' LIMIT 1) );
